name: Iris von Austria
original_name: アイリス・フォン・アウストリア
source:
A princess of the kingdom who is tout, cute and kind with a thin line.
But she is actually a bright, lively and curious girl. She wants to help her sister who is working hard as queen. She does everything she can to help the poor.

[Edited from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=842266&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
